deck_quality.notes: This deck behaves differently from most. The market slide sizes the category at $2.8B and then narrows to a $340M serviceable slice — a downward step with a stated segment definition, which is the opposite of the usual descending-percentage pattern. The competition slide names the two category leaders and concedes they dominate. Slide 6 volunteers the single most dangerous risk to the business, which is unusual and reads as confidence rather than naivety. The traction is fully specified for the stage: revenue, customer count, growth duration, retention and payback all appear. The gaps that remain are structural rather than evasive — no team, no product mechanism, no pricing — and the $20M post on $520k ARR (about 38x) is the number that will need defending.
